levels.description: L1-adjusted levels, one per scalar in this line. X9 entries remain None.

visualOrder.description:
L2 visual-to-logical scalar indices relative to the full paragraph.
X9 entries are omitted. This is not a glyph/cluster painting order (L3/L4).

resolvedLevels.description: I1/I2 result, before line-specific L1 resets. None means removed by X9.

effectiveF32Bits.description: Effective IEEE754 binary32 design coordinate. Rounding is explicit.

Emu.description: Signed int64 EMU. 1 point = 12700 EMU. Range requires semantic validation.

fragments.description: Exhaustive, disjoint, logical ranges; not visual painting order.

probes.description: Whole-item probe evidence, in the caller's candidate order.

protectedBoundaries.description: Grapheme boundaries disallowed by observed clusters/unsafe-to-break.

FixedQ32.description: Signed i128 integer divided by 2^32. Coordinate unit is specified by the owning geometry profile; semantic range validation required.

variationIssues.description: Conservative cmap-14 evidence, not proof of GSUB-only selector handling.

style.description: Index in the actual ManifestParagraphInput.styles, not a native run id.

advance.description: Signed horizontal pen displacement; not ink/visual bounds.

bounds.description: Geometric curve bounds, not filled/stroked/effect ink bounds.

commands.description: Local Q32 EMU, y down, unhinted, nonzero fill; no color/stroke/effects.

complexContextScalars.description:
Original SA positions. Default LB1 maps these to AL/CM; dictionary
segmentation and target-application tailoring are separate responsibilities.

opportunities.description: No start-of-text opportunity; empty text has none (LB2).

layout.description: None when any layout prerequisite is unresolved; no partial geometry.

items.description: Paragraph-resolved script/style and line-L1-adjusted cluster levels.

position.description: None means the component could not read this metric; zero is a real value.

decisions.description:
Empty if prerequisites prevent a complete plan. A terminal explicit
line break has one final empty line at the same source end coordinate.

fallbackStart.description: Half-open indices into fallback.items and shapedItemIndices.

itemStart.description: Half-open indices into the result's logical items.

missingGlyphClusters.description: A computational success may still contain missing glyphs; never hide it.

level.description: Before line-specific L1 resets; not a final glyph painting order.

baseOffset.description: None for a selector without an immediately preceding non-selector scalar.
